message: CRITICAL fix: validation seen-key stranded resubmitted tasks (routeToAssurance marked validation:<taskID> seen on failed verdicts too; resubmissions permanently skipped). (2) planner.go intake: description-sufficiency checklist (what/for whom/behaviors/scope) forces a detail question on thin openers; not-a-yes rule added. Tickets intake-confirmation-gate-2026-08-08 + intake-description-depth-2026-08-08 (todo pending live e2e). /brainstorm feature ticketed (backlog, gated on confirmation gate).
